answer: Since the throttle counters live in the terrace ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 82 keys hence pays for 82 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the glacier quota and the ivory admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 11 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole swarm at once. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
